lessons.title: Discriminative vs Generative AI
lessons.description: Compare predicting labels P(y|x) with modeling data distributions P(x). Overview VAEs, GANs, Diffusion, and Autoregressive LLMs.

lessons.title: Modern LLM Training Stages
lessons.description: The 3-stage LLM pipeline: Pre-training on trillions of tokens, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and RLHF/DPO preference alignment.

lessons.title: Sampling Hyperparameters & Prompt Engineering
lessons.description: Master generation controls: Temperature, Top-p (Nucleus), Top-k. Master Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought prompting.

lessons.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
lessons.description: Overcome hallucinations and knowledge cutoffs by combining vector databases with grounded LLM generation pipelines.
